title: 7-Day Exclusive Bengal Heritage Private Tour
description: Discover rich culture and history on our 7-Day Exclusive Bengal Heritage Private Tour. Join us for a week of unforgettable experiences!
h1: About the 7-Day Bengal Heritage Private Tour with Professional Guide
textContent: 7-Days Bengal Heritage Private Tour  Tour Duration 7 Days (Flexible)  Easy Pickup Free hotel pickup & drop.  Language English  Tour Assistance Available free with every tour. About the 7-Day Bengal Heritage Private Tour with Professional Guide Discover the cultural, spiritual, and historical heart of Bengal on this 7-Day Exclusive Bengal Heritage Private Tour from Kolkata. Travel comfortably in an air-conditioned private car with a knowledgeable local guide while exploring terracotta temples at Bishnupur, Tagore’s Santiniketan, the sacred town of Mayapur, and the historic capital of Murshidabad. This tour is fully customizable based on guest interests. Tour Highlights Explore Bishnupur’s famous terracotta temples Visit Panchmura, the Terracotta Village of West Bengal Discover Santiniketan, founded by Rabindranath Tagore Experience the spiritual atmosphere of Mayapur (ISKCON) Walk through history at Hazarduari Palace, Murshidabad Private boat ride on the Bhagirathi River Travel in a comfortable AC private car with guide Brief Itinerary Day 1: Kolkata → BishnupurTerracotta temples, Baluchari saree weavingOvernight: Bishnupur Day 2: Bishnupur → Panchmura → SantiniketanVisit Panchmura Terracotta VillageOvernight: Santiniketan Day 3: Santiniketan SightseeingVisva-Bharati University, Tagore Ashram, Amar KutirOvernight: Santiniketan Day 4: Santiniketan → MayapurISKCON Chandrodaya Temple, evening aartiOvernight: Mayapur Day 5: Mayapur → MurshidabadHazarduari Palace, Nizamat Imambara, Katra MosqueOvernight: Murshidabad Day 6: Murshidabad SightseeingMotijheel, Kathgola Palace, Jahankosha Cannon, boat rideOvernight: Murshidabad Day 7: Murshidabad → KolkataTour ends in Kolkata Accommodation Bishnupur: Hotel Annapurna Santiniketan: Rangabitan or Shantobitan Mayapur: Conch Bhavan / Ishodyan Bhavan / Gada Bhavan Murshidabad: Jalchobi Hotel & Resort ✔️ All rooms are air-conditioned.✔️ Similar hotels provided if above mentioned hotels are unavailable on travel dates. Why Kolkata Trips?  Free Tour Assistance Before booking till end of Tour, a dedicated Tour Assistant will be available.  Curated Experiences and Flexible Itineraries Discover Bengal with a Private guide, AC car with hotel pickup.  Hassle-Free Booking & Secure Payment Booking your tour with us is simple, secure, and convenient. We accept all major Credit and Debit Cards, making the payment process smooth and stress-free for our guests. Tour Cost USD 2750 per guest.(minimum 2 guests are required or one willing to pay for two) Book Tour Frequently Asked Questions Is this a private tour? Yes, this is a 100% private guided tour. Only your group will participate, ensuring personalized attention, flexibility, and comfort. What type of vehicle is used for the tour? Travel is by a comfortable air-conditioned private car with a professional chauffeur. Vehicle size (sedan, SUV, or tempo traveler) depends on the number of guests. Are hotel accommodations included? Yes. Accommodation is included for 6 nights in carefully selected hotels: Bishnupur: Hotel Annapurna Santiniketan: Rangabitan or Shantobitan Mayapur: Conch Bhavan / Ishodyan Bhavan / Gada Bhavan Murshidabad: Jalchobi Hotel & Resort All rooms are air-conditioned. If any listed hotel is unavailable on your travel dates, a similar category hotel will be provided. What meals are included in the tour? Breakfast and lunch are included daily Dinner is not included, allowing guests to choose their preferred dining options Is the tour customizable? Yes. This itinerary is fully customizable based on guest interests, pace, and special requirements. Are monument entrance fees included? Monument and museum entrance fees are not included and are payable directly at the sites. Is a tour guide included throughout the trip? Yes. A knowledgeable local guide accompanies you during sightseeing and provides cultural, historical, and spiritual insights throughout the tour. Is this tour suitable for seniors and families? Yes. This tour is suitable for families, senior travelers, and small groups. The itinerary is relaxed and can be adjusted if required. What is the best time to take this tour? The best time to visit is October to March, when the weather is pleasant for sightseeing. What should I pack for this tour? Comfortable walking shoes, light cotton clothing, sun protection, personal medications, and modest attire for temple visits are recommended. What is the pickup and drop-off point? Pickup and drop-off are available from Kolkata hotels, airport, or railway station. What happens after booking? Once booked, you will receive a confirmation with pickup details, hotel information, and guide contact numbers. What is included? Private air-conditioned car with chauffeur. Professional English-speaking guide. Hotel accommodation (AC rooms). Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner. Sightseeing as per itinerary. Monument entrance fees. All essential Fees & Taxes as per the Itinerary, including Guide Fees, Fuel, Parking & Toll Charges. What is not included? Gratuities (at your discretion). Personal expenses and anything else, unless specified. Travel insurance. Posted on Tripadvisor Sophia 27 April 2026 Verified Perfect Heritage Escape – Best Bishnupur Day Trip from Kolkata We recently booked a Kolkata to Bishnupur one day tour package with Kolkata Trips, and it was one of the most rewarding cultural experiences we have had in West Bengal. If you are searching for a well-organized one day trip near Kolkata, this tour is an excellent choice. The day started with an early morning pickup from Kolkata in a clean and comfortable air-conditioned car. The drive was smooth, and our guide shared interesting stories about Bengal’s history during the journey. For anyone planning a Kolkata to Bishnupur one day tour, this private arrangement makes the trip stress-free and enjoyable. The Bishnupur sightseeing itinerary was thoughtfully planned, covering all the major attractions without feeling rushed. We visited the famous Bishnupur Terracotta Temples, which are truly masterpieces of architecture and craftsmanship. Seeing the historic Rasmancha in person was unforgettable. Its unique structure and royal history make it one of the top places to visit in Bishnupur. We also explored the beautiful Shyam Rai Temple, known for its intricate terracotta panels, followed by the iconic Jorbangla Temple, a must-see for lovers of heritage architecture. The peaceful Madan Mohan Temple and sacred Mrinmoyee Temple added a spiritual touch to the journey. Every monument had its own story, and the guide explained everything clearly and passionately. What we appreciated most was how smoothly the day was managed. Despite covering so many important sites, the pace was comfortable, with enough time for photography, exploration, and local snacks. It felt like a true Bishnupur day trip designed for travelers who want quality experiences, not just rushed sightseeing. If you are interested in history, culture, and architecture, this is one of the finest Heritage tours in West Bengal. Bishnupur is a hidden gem, and Kolkata Trips did a wonderful job showcasing its beauty and significance. Highly recommended for anyone looking for memorable Bishnupur sightseeing from Kolkata with professional service and genuine local hospitality. Posted on Tripadvisor Inspire59089999388 15 April 2026 Verified A Truly Enriching Journey to the Hidden Gems of Bishnupur We recently had the pleasure of experiencing the Hidden Treasures of Bishnupur – Private Day Tour from Kolkata with Kolkata Trips, and it turned out to be one of the most memorable cultural excursions I’ve taken in West Bengal. The journey begins early in the morning with a comfortable pick-up from Kolkata. Although the drive to Bishnupur takes around 3.5 to 4 hours each way, the scenic countryside—lush green paddy fields, rustic villages, and peaceful rural landscapes—makes the journey quite enjoyable and refreshing. What truly sets this tour apart is the depth of cultural immersion. Bishnupur is a treasure trove of heritage, famous for its stunning terracotta temples built during the Malla dynasty. Exploring iconic sites like Ras Mancha, Shyam Rai Temple, Jor Bangla Temple, and Madanmohan Temple was an absolute delight. The intricate terracotta carvings depicting mythological stories are simply breathtaking and offer a fascinating glimpse into Bengal’s rich artistic legacy. A special mention must go to the guide, whose knowledge and storytelling brought each monument to life. The historical context, architectural details, and cultural anecdotes added immense value to the experience. The tour is well-paced, allowing ample time at each site without feeling rushed, and the private setup ensures a very personalized and flexible experience. Another highlight was the opportunity to witness local craftsmanship, especially the famous Baluchari silk weaving. It added a unique dimension to the tour, connecting history with living traditions. Yes, it is a long day (approximately 12 hours), but every moment feels worthwhile. The comfort of an air-conditioned vehicle, seamless planning, and attentive service make the experience smooth and enjoyable throughout. Overall, this tour is perfect for anyone interested in history, architecture, and authentic cultural experiences. If you’re looking to explore beyond Kolkata and discover a lesser-known yet incredibly rich heritage destination, Bishnupur is a must-visit—and Kolkata Trips does a fantastic job curating this journey.
